name: Yukeles Hoen Gran
original_name: ユークレース・ホーン・グラン
source:
Prince of the 'Earth Country Gran'.
He was chosen to pour power into the 'magic stone'.
A kind person who is good at looking after people. He's always smiling and putting out a warm atmosphere.
It's his duty to mediate between the other princes when they're arguing. He rarely gets angry himself, but when others don't follow the rules he can be really scary.
